text:
tess: Heads-up — thinking through onboarding ABI for model metadata and quick smoke checks. Want to decide blocking vs advisory. Details below.

ori: +1 for an ABI, we need a stable manifest so runtime picks right kernels.

michael: propose model.metadata.v1 JSON with fields: arch, kv_layout, quantization_hint, sequence_profile_id, perf_baseline_tag

jia: how strict should validation be? I worry about false rejects for experimental quantization.

tess: tradeoff: strict blocking reduces bad rollouts but costs more onboarding effort. Alternative: soft-gate with fail_count threshold and auto-rollback on perf regressions.

ori: suggestion: two-tier gates — smoke (fast, <5s) blocking for correctness/compat; bench (costly) advisory with SLA annotations. Smoke must cover e2e kv-cache correctness + deterministic outputs for golden inputs.

michael: agreed. smoke battery:
```
ci/onboard_smoke.sh --model $MODEL --golden-set=golden/2026-v2 --max-latency=150ms --kv-check
```
should run in the ingest job and must pass within 3 tries.

jia: whats in golden set? small curated prompts that cover tokenization, long context, and trick prompts for EOS/stop.

tess: include fuzz inputs and a seed so outputs deterministic. also check KV cache replay: feed prefix, then continue twice and compare logits at step N.

ori: compatibility matrix idea: map model arch x runtime capability -> recommended kernel/quant setting. If missing, onboard marks `compatibility: advisory` and suggests a shim.

michael: add a 'latency_floor' metric measured with 8A samples to catch pathological attention implementations.

jia: costs: bench per model ~ $X per run, so run weekly for popular models and on-demand otherwise.

tess: final ask: agree on metadata schema and smoke checklist by EOD Thu. If we go with two-tier gates we can reduce early friction.

ori: +1. I'll draft the manifest PR: model.metadata.v1 schema + example.

michael: I'll add smoke runner and kv-replay test to `ingest/` tests.

deploy-bot: deploy job queued: onboard-smoke-runner -> ingest-pool (job id: 389102)

tess: thanks all. If anyone wants to object to blocking smoke elements ping me.
